claims.text: A single algorithm drives a health care decision for over 70 million people in the US.
Patients anticipated to have complex and intensive future health care needs are enrolled in care management programs.
Care management programs provide greater attention from trained providers.
Care management programs provide help with coordination of care.

evidence.description: A single algorithm drives an important health care decision for over 70 million people in the US.
When health systems anticipate that a patient will have especially complex and intensive future health care needs, she is enrolled in a 'care management' program
care management program... provides considerable additional resources: greater attention from trained providers
care management program... provides considerable additional resources: ... help with coordination of her care.

methodologies.name: Algorithm-guided care management program enrollment
methodologies.description: Health systems use an algorithmic prediction of future care needs to select high-need patients for targeted care management programs.
